# `face_diff.xml` fixtures

Lead-written sources for the tests of a face diff given as text (step 4.5d, TC-MOD-15),
generated by `scripts/provenance/fixtures/face_diff_fixtures.py`. Do not edit them by hand;
change the script and rerun it.

No loose `face_diff.xml` exists on the maintainer's machine (2026-10-03), so each fixture is a
real `face_diff.bin` from a cup export, encoded with Python's `base64`, an encoder independent
of the crate the compiler decodes with. Neither bin equals the bundled template
(`resources/templates/face_diff.bin`), so a test can tell a decoded file from an injected one.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `dif.xml` | the `<dif>` form, as Red's `diff_from_xml` writes it: an XML declaration, then a `<dif>` root whose text is the base64 on one line between two line breaks (CRLF, as written on Windows) |
| `dif.bin` | what `dif.xml` decodes to: 944 bytes, the length its header gives (from `SMBG Aesthetics Export VGL26`, `Faces/XXX06- Miyamoto`) |
| `plain.xml` | the base64 alone, no XML, wrapped at 76 columns with CRLF line breaks |
| `plain.bin` | what `plain.xml` decodes to: 960 bytes with a header that gives 944, the 16-byte-longer class that 326 of the machine's 2,695 loose `face_diff.bin` belong to (from `JP 2026 Winter Aesthetic Additions for Day 2`, `Faces/XXX14 - Lemontene`) |
